<!-- Generated by scripts/cli_reference.py from the help of the huron CLI. After you change the help, run `uv run python scripts/cli_reference.py`. -->

List the catalogs of the current organization and mark the current one, or select one.

Panel: [Catalog](/docs/reference/cli/panels/catalog/).

## Usage

```text
huron catalog [OPTIONS] [NAME]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Description                                                                        |
| -------- | ---- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `NAME`   | str  | Select this catalog. With no argument, list the catalogs and mark the current one. |
